# Voice

**Figma:** Voice Recorder (15084:79711) + AI Voice Conversation (15084:79715) (page 15081:1294)  
**Import:** `import { VoiceRecorder, AiVoiceConversation } from "@zen/design-system";`

Record a voice take, or talk with the assistant out loud: a waveform or voice signal, what the state means, and three voice actions around one main action.

## Use it for
- Voice notes on a task, a comment or a ticket (VoiceRecorder).
- Recording a take before attaching or sending it.
- Voice mode with the assistant: listening, answering, interrupting (AiVoiceConversation).
- Full-screen voice on a phone.

## Use something else for
- A voice message already sent in a chat → ChatVoice (Chat/Bubble/Voice).
- Dictating into the prompt → AiChatField listening.
- Audio playback of a file → a media player, not a recorder.

## Figma → React
| Figma | Prop | Values / notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| State | `state` | VoiceRecorder ready · recording · paused; AiVoiceConversation ready · listening · responding — your recorder or assistant drives it |
| Recorder actions | `onRecord · onPause · onResume · onFinish · onDiscard` | the main action follows the state; Discard and Finish stay off until there is a take |
| Conversation actions | `onStart · onDone · onInterrupt · onEnd · muted + onMutedChange` | Mute and End stay off until the conversation starts |
| Waveform | `elapsed · start · end · levels (0–1)` | Heading/Subheading time, an 80px waveform, Caption start / end |
| Transcript | `transcript · speaker` | the AI/Chat-Bubble inside the Surface/Alt card |
| Footer | `input · format (Recorder) · note (Conversation)` | Caption, Neutral/Light |

## Props
Generated from the TypeScript source; full JSON in `docs/api/voice.json`.

### VoiceRecorder
Figma Voice Recorder (15084:79711): a header (Body/Base/Medium name + a Small Subtle Badge: Neutral Ready / Paused, Red Recording with its dot), the audio monitor (Background/Surface/Alt, Corner-Radius/Base, Spacing/Padding/Medium: the elapsed time in Heading/Subheading, an 80px waveform — Content/Neutral/Strongest while recording, Neutral/Light paused, a flat Border/Neutral/Subtle line when ready — and its start / end times in Caption/Regular Neutral/Light), the guidance (Body/Small/Regular Neutral/Base), the transport (Discard · Record/Pause/Resume · Finish; Discard and Finish disabled until there is a take), a Border/Neutral/Pale divider and the input details.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `state` | `"ready" \| "recording" \| "paused"` | `"ready"` | Figma State: Ready (nothing recorded yet), Recording, Paused. Your recorder drives it. |
| `title` | `ReactNode` | — | The header's name of the take. Default: the locale's "New recording". |
| `elapsed` | `string` | `"00:00.00"` | The take's length so far ("00:24.18"), Heading/Subheading. |
| `start` | `string` | `"00:00"` | The waveform window's start and end times under it ("00:16", "00:24"). |
| `end` | `string` | `"00:00"` |  |
| `levels` | _HTML attribute_ | — | The recent sound levels, 0–1 each, oldest first (Figma draws 56). Unset: Figma's sample take; Ready: a flat line. |
| `guidance` | `ReactNode` | — | The line under the waveform. Default: what the state means ("Capturing audio from your microphone."). |
| `input` | `ReactNode` | — | The footer: the input device ("Built-in microphone") and the format ("48 kHz · Mono"). |
| `format` | `ReactNode` | — |  |
| `onRecord` | `() => void` | — | Record (Ready), Pause (Recording) and Resume (Paused): the main action. Without the handler for the current state it is off, e.g. leave out `onResume` once a take reaches its length limit. |
| `onPause` | `() => void` | — |  |
| `onResume` | `() => void` | — |  |
| `onFinish` | `() => void` | — | Finish the take (Recording, Paused). |
| `onDiscard` | `() => void` | — | Throw the take away (Recording, Paused). |
| `className` | `string` | — |  |

Figma AI Voice Conversation (15084:79715): the header (Body/Base/Medium name + a Small Subtle Badge with its dot: Neutral Ready, Accent Listening / Responding), the 96px voice signal (Corner-Radius/Rounded: Background/Surface/Alt with the microphone when ready, Background/Accent/Subtle with 4px Content/Accent/Light bars, Spacing/Gap/2XSmall apart), the status (Heading/Subheading + Body/Small/Regular Neutral/Light), the transcript card (Background/Surface/Alt, Corner-Radius/Base, Spacing/Padding/Small: the speaker in Label/Small/Medium Neutral/Light over an AI/Chat-Bubble), the actions (Mute · Start talking / Done speaking / Interrupt · End) and the note.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `state` | `"ready" \| "listening" \| "responding"` | `"ready"` | Figma State: Ready (the microphone is off), Listening (you talk), Responding (the assistant answers). |
| `name` | `ReactNode` | — | The assistant's name in the header. Default: the locale's "Zen voice". |

| `headingLevel` | `2 \| 3 \| 4 \| 5 \| 6` | `3` | The status heading's level in the page outline (an `h3` by default; `2` straight under a screen's h1). |
| `guidance` | `ReactNode` | — |  |

| `onMutedChange` | `(muted: boolean) => void` | — |  |
| `onStart` | `() => void` | — | The main action: Start talking (Ready), Done speaking (Listening), Interrupt (Responding). |
| `onDone` | `() => void` | — |  |
| `onInterrupt` | `() => void` | — |  |
| `onEnd` | `() => void` | — | End the conversation (off while Ready). |
| `note` | `ReactNode` | — | The note under the actions (Caption/Regular Neutral/Light). Default: what the microphone is doing. |

## ✅ Do
- Put them on a Card or a Surface: the frame itself is transparent (Figma).
- Wire every action you show: a main action without its handler does nothing (harness: voice/actions-wired).
- Let your audio code drive state, and give the time and levels from it.
- On a phone, use a white screen (canvas surface) so the Surface/Alt signal and card show.

## ❌ Don't
- Don't start recording or listening without a press: the microphone stays off until Record / Start talking.
- Don't hide the state's meaning in colour alone: the Badge and the guidance line say it in words.
- Don't use AiVoiceConversation for a recording to send: that is VoiceRecorder.

## Accessibility
- Each voice action is a named button (its name is printed under it); Mute is a toggle (aria-pressed).
- The guidance and status lines are polite live regions, so a state change is announced once.
- The waveform and voice signal are decorative (aria-hidden): the time and the Badge carry the meaning.

## Content
- Guidance says what is happening now and what to do next, in one sentence.
- Times read as Figma's: 00:24.18 for the take, 00:24 for the timeline.

## Harness (`npm run usage:check`)
| Rule | Severity | Checks | Suppress with |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `voice/actions-wired` | warn | A Voice component shows its main action in every state: wire it (VoiceRecorder onRecord · onPause · onResume; AiVoiceConversation onStart · onDone · onInterrupt), or the big button does nothing. | `zen-allow-voice-actions: <reason>` |
| `interaction/no-noop-handler` | warn | Every interaction a Zen control offers works: no no-op handlers (`() => {}`, `() => undefined`), which leave a field that ignores typing and ↑/↓ or a Dismiss that stays. Chat has chat/no-locked-interaction. | `zen-allow-noop-handler: <reason>` |
| `interaction/controlled-needs-handler` | warn | A controlled prop comes with its change handler (month + onMonthChange, value + onValueChange, open + onOpenChange, pageSize + onPageSizeChange…): without it nothing can change the value and the control is frozen, e.g. a DatePicker whose Previous/Next do nothing. Bare booleans (a fixed preview) and `x ? true : undefined` pins pass. | `zen-allow-controlled-handler: <reason>` |
